episodes.title: Maigret Sets a Trap
episodes.summary: The summer of 1955 finds Paris in the grip of both sweltering heat and terror on the streets. Four women have been murdered in Montmartre, with no apparent connection between the victims. Chief Inspector Maigret comes under huge pressure from the public and his superiors to apprehend the killer before he can strike again.

episodes.title: Maigret's Dead Man
episodes.summary: In Maigret's Dead Man, a series of vicious, murderous attacks on three wealthy farms in Picardy hit the national headlines and the elite Brigade Criminelle at the Quay Des Orfevres is called upon to lend its expertise in tracking down the brutal gang responsible for the slaughter. However, Maigret is resolute in investigating the murder of an obscure anonymous Parisian. An investigation that ultimately solves both crimes.

episodes.title: Maigret's Night at the Crossroads
episodes.summary: Maigret faces a wall of silence from the inhabitants at a remote crossroads as he investigates the murder of a Jewish diamond dealer, who was killed in the dead of night.

episodes.title: Maigret in Montmartre
episodes.summary: Maigret investigates the random murders of a Countess and a Showgirl and discovers a dark secret that links their past lives at the Grand Hotel in Nice.
